title: Slices of the critical part of a C¹ chart piece are H^m-null for a.e. level (Simon Ch. 2, 6.3–6.4; via Eilenberg)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m+1, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P of class C¹ which is K-Lipschitz on Ω and satisfies c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| on Ω for some c > 0, h : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹, f : ℝ^P → ℝ arbitrary, and W ⊆ Φ(Ω) Borel such that f(Φ(w)) = h(w) and Dh(w) = 0 for every w ∈ Ω with Φ(w) ∈ W. Then H^m(W ∩ f⁻¹{t}) = 0 for Lebesgue-a.e. t ∈ ℝ (Hᵏ := μHE[k]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ Φ '' Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w ∈ W → f (Φ w) = h w ∧ fderiv ℝ h w = 0) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0
